properties.description: Manage bank accounts and linked accounts, track balances, detect dormant accounts, compute account metrics, and maintain account lifecycle state.
properties.failure_impact: Account data becomes inconsistent. Users cannot track balances or detect dormant accounts leading to inaccurate financial position reporting.

properties.description: Analyze credit card statements, compute utilization ratios, track outstanding balances, detect EMI conversions and cash advances, and optimize credit card repayment strategies.
properties.failure_impact: Credit card repayment planning breaks. Users cannot optimize payment strategies or understand true cost of revolving debt, leading to excessive interest charges.

properties.description: Compute loan schedules, EMI calculations, foreclosure amounts, prepayment simulations, and loan health metrics for personal loans and other debt instruments.
properties.failure_impact: Loan repayment planning breaks. Users cannot determine correct EMIs, foreclosure amounts, or prepayment savings, leading to incorrect debt decisions.

properties.description: Track lifecycle of financial events across accounts including settlements, rollovers, refunds, and transfers with full lineage and audit trail.
properties.failure_impact: Event tracking breaks. Users lose audit trail for settlements, refunds, and transfers, making transaction history incomplete and non-compliant.

properties.description: Assess financial health through behaviour profiling, resilience scoring, stress detection, savings rate analysis, and wellness metrics derived from transaction patterns.
properties.failure_impact: Financial health assessments become unreliable. Users lose visibility into behaviour patterns, stress indicators, and wellness scores needed for corrective action.

properties.description: Project future cashflow, liquidity, and financial goals using deterministic forecasting models, scenario analysis, and optimization algorithms.
properties.failure_impact: Long-term planning becomes unreliable. Users cannot project liquidity, set achievable financial goals, or evaluate what-if scenarios for major decisions.

properties.description: Compute monthly household cashflow analysis including income, expenses, surplus/deficit, true savings adjusted for financial events, and credit dependency ratios.
properties.failure_impact: Core financial visibility. Loss causes inability to determine surplus/deficit, leading to incorrect budget and planning decisions.

properties.description: Identify spending patterns, liquidity patterns, and recurring transaction categories to improve cashflow classification and financial insights.
properties.failure_impact: Pattern detection breaks. Users lose automated categorization and recurring transaction identification, reducing cashflow accuracy and insight generation.

properties.description: Generate personalized financial recommendations based on account state, behaviour scores, cashflow patterns, and optimization algorithms.
properties.failure_impact: Users miss actionable insights. No optimization suggestions or behavioural nudges reduce platform's ability to drive positive financial change.

properties.description: Match debit and credit transactions across accounts to identify matched pairs, unmatched items, and settlement patterns using deterministic bipartite matching algorithms.
properties.failure_impact: Reconciliation accuracy breaks. Users cannot verify transaction completeness or detect missing/suspicious transactions across accounts, undermining audit confidence.

properties.description: Detect hidden financial patterns in transactions including credit card payments, loan EMIs, and cash conversion cycles to improve cashflow accuracy and spending classification.
properties.failure_impact: Hidden financial obligations go undetected. Users miss credit card payments, loan EMIs, and cash conversion cycles, leading to inaccurate cashflow and unexpected charges.
